landing.example.card1: Works only with weddings and toi. The description mentions 13 years of experience and 356 weddings. The starting price of 900 000 ₸ leaves 100 000 ₸ under the example limit. The price was filled in during data preparation and needs confirming.
landing.example.card2: The only one of the three who also hosts in English. The description names the bride's farewell and the first-steps ceremony. Up to 10 hours in the catalogue, 2 hours more than the example duration. Starting price 900 000 ₸.
landing.example.card3: According to the description, a stage and film actor and TV presenter who hosts in Kazakh. The starting price of 1 000 000 ₸ equals the example limit, so the total may be higher. Up to 8 hours in the catalogue, with no margin over the example duration.

landing.faq.title: Before matching
landing.faq.a1: Set requirements, save them in this tab and explore the prepared example. Matching on new requirements is not available yet.
landing.faq.q2: Do I need to sign up?
landing.faq.a2: Not for the form or the example. Search will also be open to guests once it is added.
landing.faq.a3: The maximum starting price of one contractor in the chosen category. It is not the total event budget.
landing.faq.a4: The service is built for a short list. The example shows three records chosen in advance. It is not a result of the current form.
landing.faq.a5: From the organisers' anonymised CSV, with {profiles} profiles in the catalogue. Marks for synthetic profiles, filled-in prices and filled-in cities come from the source data.
landing.faq.a6: Tandau does not handle bookings or payments.
landing.faq.a7: In this tab, if browser storage is available. The “Clear” action deletes them. Saving to an account is not connected yet.
